lines.caption: I live in your browser, on every page you read.
lines.spoken: I live in your browser, on every page you read.

lines.caption: See a company in the news? Hold ⌥V and ask me about it.
lines.spoken: See a company in the news? Hold Option V and ask me about it.

lines.caption: Looking at a chart? I'll explain it, and draw right on it.
lines.spoken: Looking at a chart? I'll explain it, and draw right on it.

lines.caption: Want in? Say “buy ten dollars of Tesla”, and I'll buy it on Robinhood Chain.
lines.spoken: Want in? Say, buy ten dollars of Tesla, and I'll buy it on Robinhood Chain.

lines.caption: I trade from a vault you own, inside limits you set. I can never withdraw a cent.
lines.spoken: I trade from a vault you own, inside limits you set. I can never withdraw a cent.

lines.caption: When the market's closed, I slow down on my own.
lines.spoken: When the market's closed, I slow down on my own.

lines.caption: Pause me any time. Revoke me any time.
lines.spoken: Pause me any time. Revoke me any time.
